notes: Only existing-account UI sign-in paths are exercised; signup, provider identity, invalid OTP and full lifecycle remain uncovered.
Workspace-specific login, role denial and explicit logout are exercised for selected personas; full cross-workspace session and stale-cookie matrix remains incomplete.
UI sessions are created and parent logout is checked against protected endpoints; expiry, refresh-token replay, revocation after permission change and Android process restore remain uncovered.
Parent-to-parent child-ID substitution is tested; the complete guardian access matrix is not yet covered.
Selected tenant boundary and persisted assignments are checked; all tenant-scoped resources and selection states are not.
HRMS platform-owner authorization is checked against Education Admin and parent sessions; complete HRMS role matrix is not.

Executed in the full-stack E2E run: installs the versioned starter pack through HRMS UI in the disposable DB; asserts the persisted run/resource manifest, three institution rows, complete planned-vs-created resource counts and linked synthetic identities; calls the live QA verification endpoint and requires zero failed ownership checks.

Executed in the full-stack E2E run: UI previews cleanup, exact run-ID confirmation is required, uninstall is scoped to the owned run, persisted owned rows are absent/marked cleaned, baseline verification passes, and teardown removes only run-owned resources.
Approved disposable database status is asserted; negative configuration matrix and zero-write rejection tests are not covered.

Learner API course lists are checked against three fixture institutions and a forged tenant selector must be denied or return no rows; marketplace visibility and direct content URLs still need separate coverage.
Sign-in uses the selected institution code; a forged cross-institution selector is denied or safely empty. Missing, malformed, suspended, and active-nonmember institution selections remain untested.

Executed in the full-stack E2E run: same pack/version/idempotency key replay returns the same run, does not re-disclose one-time credentials, and direct PostgreSQL assertion confirms exactly one run row; a separate isolation test creates distinct-key runs and verifies separate resource manifests.

The enrolled-course API is checked for three fixture personas and their assigned classes; the Courses and Marketplace screens are opened responsively, but full UI-to-offer equality and Android parity remain uncovered.

Executed in the full-stack E2E run: creates runs A and B with distinct keys, captures B's owned-row counts and manifest, uninstalls only A using its exact ID, and asserts A has no remaining domain rows while B's resources/manifest and QuantaEdge Classes 6–8 baseline are unchanged.

Responsive checks exercise learner Courses/Marketplace, parent home, Admin Content Studio and HRMS QA at 320/375/430/768/1280/1440 CSS px and check page overflow/uncaught errors; keyboard/screen-reader behavior, all-route responsive coverage, contrast and Android remain uncovered.

Source-discovered web routes are visited and navigation failures, HTTP 5xx and uncaught browser errors are collected; explicit offline, retry, loading, empty, validation and permission-denied states remain uncovered.
Executed in the full-stack E2E run: authenticated Education Admin /legacy-content route redirects to /content and the test asserts the alias navigation issues no mutating API request.

Parent report and certificate listing are accessed for the linked child, and report lesson/question aggregates are compared to direct tenant-scoped PostgreSQL queries; child switching, empty-state and error recovery remain uncovered.
Parent certificate list access is verified for the linked child and a cross-parent request is denied; issued certificate preview/download and revoked file behavior remain uncovered.

Parent report course/lesson/question aggregates are compared with direct PostgreSQL values for the exact child/course/institution; lesson completion interaction, dashboard refresh and Android parity remain uncovered.
Live system status and actuator health are checked for consistent health/degraded semantics and secret-free payloads; toggling missing OTP/admin/provider configurations remains uncovered.

Fresh disposable DB must expose successful Flyway history through the QA lifecycle migration, expected tenant/course/QA relations and key/FK constraints; migration replay, upgrade-from-old-schema and seed-disabled baseline checks remain uncovered.

An enrolled learner loads run-owned published lessons in the assigned course, direct cross-tenant course/lesson API reads are rejected, the learner UI blocks a foreign-course lesson deep link before displaying the foreign title, and returned IDs are compared with run-owned PostgreSQL source rows; draft/unpublished, stale-cache and Android paths remain uncovered.

A run-owned published MCQ is answered incorrectly and retried correctly through the learner UI; each outcome is checked against the live API and PostgreSQL. Other question types, standalone practice sessions and Android parity remain uncovered.

The learner Courses screen displays the assigned course and lessons are loaded via the course/subject-scoped endpoint with source-row comparison; chapter navigation, next/previous, resume after refresh and Android remain uncovered.

Wrong STAFF_LOGIN OTP is rejected through the browser UI and auth/me remains unauthenticated before the valid code is submitted; signup OTP, expiry, throttling and other workspace purposes remain uncovered.

Child A successfully signs in through the student-login UI with the intended parent, and a mismatched guardian mobile is rejected without establishing a session or changing credential rows; password reset/update flows, weak-password cases and repeated resets remain uncovered.

The authenticated HRMS Notification Studio loads templates and audience options from the live API; invalid audience configuration is blocked before a preview POST, send remains disabled, and direct PostgreSQL counts for templates/campaigns/recipients stay unchanged. Template save/versioning, audience preview with real recipients, delivery, read/unread inbox persistence and provider delivery remain uncovered.
